content: Schema-driven table/form editor patterns: a field/column specification drives form rendering, table cells, and validation from one definition. RJSF Registry pattern = dependency-injection container of fields, widgets, templates, schemaUtils, formContext, translateString with layered precedence (field-level ui:field > ui:widget > form-level fields/widgets > theme > core default). OpenG2P widget registry: named widget lookup with fallback + plugin registration; Sections->Panels->Widgets hierarchy; validation built-in + Zod; conditional show/hide/enable; data sources static/API/schema-ref; inline editable tables with per-column widget type; dirty tracking. reaktiform: ColumnDef carries type, readOnly (bool or row=>bool), min/max/(row)=>value cross-field constraints, computed columns with dependency tracking, undo/redo, cell renderer/renderEditCell separation. Sources: RJSF DeepWiki, OpenG2P docs, reaktiform README (mixed official/community).
